easyPrerequisites:
Oko has five or more loyalty counters on it.
An opponent controls a creature with power 3 or less.
description:
Activate Oko's last ability by removing five loyalty counters from it, exchanging control of a creature an opponent controls with power 3 or less and Old Fat Spider.
Activate Soltari Guerrillas an arbitrarily large number of times by paying {0}, targeting Old Fat Spider.
Altanak triggers that many times, causing its controller to draw that many cards and lose the game due to drawing from an empty library.
